The mean strategy balances these factors and is likely to generalise better to the blind test window.
loop.top3_why_not: A (best_single) shows a very large error in window 1 (0.5356) and a very small error in window 2 (0.0843), indicating over‑fitting to one window and instability in the blind period.  C (trimmed_mean) has similar instability to B but with a higher overall error (0.1910) and a larger gap to the best score.  Therefore, B offers the best trade‑off between stability and performance.
